scope: All feature families requested after the M00-M04 foundation; staged input-to-render delivery.
priority_policy: Proposed dependency-led order; scoped Blender static input can proceed after its static scene/material dependencies. Existing milestone dependencies still apply.
common_done: A licensed or independently authored external input fixture
Browser-local evaluation/render validation within a published budget
Typed failures and explicit losses; immutable authored revisions on failure
Resource measurements, dependency/provenance inventory and truthful capability axes

tracks.title: Complete static glTF/GLB scenes
deliverables: GLB container and glTF resource bundles with bounded Rust decoding
Indexed/nonindexed geometry, multiple primitives and meshes, accessor strides, normalized and sparse attributes
Selected scene, hierarchy, shared instances, matrix/TRS transforms and camera semantics
Source normals, UV sets and material assignments retained through conversion
Rust PNG/JPEG texture decoding with explicit color roles, samplers and alpha handling
acceptance: Import, persist, reopen and render licensed external multi-object fixtures through native and browser APIs
Verify node world transforms, bounds, instance sharing and per-primitive material assignment against known values
Reject malformed offsets, cycles, missing resources and excessive allocations without committed changes
Retain source identity and report unsupported extensions or intentional losses
tracks.qualification: Static scene completeness also depends on INPUT-02 for core PBR material evaluation. Reading or preserving a field is not rendering support.
tracks.implemented_profile: gltf2-static-pbr-v0; gltf2-sparse-uv0-v1 accessor capability; gltf2-alpha-cpu-v1 MASK/BLEND import; gltf2-named-uv-v1 per-role UV0..UV7 on CPU/Metal/WebGPU; gltf2-vertex-color-v1 linear COLOR_0 on CPU/Metal/WebGPU with CPU/Metal/WebGPU Principled MASK/BLEND coverage; gpu-f32-principled-alpha-v1 MASK/BLEND with selected UV/vertex alpha, bounded visibility and shutter failure propagation
tracks.remaining_scope: Additional color sets, material extensions and authored hierarchy/camera/light export remain unsupported; evaluated PBR GLB export preserves UVs, colors, local frames, representable transforms and encoded textures.
tracks.export_profile: gltf2-evaluated-pbr-export-v1; selected evaluated surface/pose with embedded resources and explicit authoring/render-recipe losses

tracks.title: glTF PBR and richer surface shaders
deliverables: Metallic/roughness surface scattering and supported dielectric/conductor models
Base-color, metallic/roughness, normal, emissive and occlusion texture semantics
Alpha modes, single/double-sided behavior and explicitly scoped layered/transmission profiles
Matching CPU and Rust-generated GPU material evaluation with explicit approximation policies
acceptance: Analytic Fresnel, energy/PDF, white-furnace and sample-distribution checks
Matched native/browser GPU and CPU images within declared tolerances
Reference scenes demonstrate material differences, normal maps, transparency and multiple UV roles
Unknown shader nodes are reported individually and retained safely where possible
tracks.qualification: Core glTF materials and named extensions are separate capabilities. Blender node graphs require explicitly supported node semantics.
tracks.implemented_profile: glTF opaque CPU/Metal/WebGPU finite-depth 1–16 transport plus native-authored extended Rust CPU surfaces; gltf2-alpha-cpu-v1 MASK/BLEND import; gltf2-named-uv-v1 per-role UV0..UV7 on CPU/Metal/WebGPU; gltf2-vertex-color-v1 linear COLOR_0 on CPU/Metal/WebGPU with CPU/Metal/WebGPU Principled MASK/BLEND coverage; gpu-f32-principled-alpha-v1 MASK/BLEND with selected UV/vertex alpha, bounded visibility and shutter failure propagation; gpu-f32-conductor-coat-v1 native-authored conductor and single-interface coat on Metal/WebGPU with shared alpha and shutter workflows; gpu-f32-dielectric-v1 native-authored ideal geometric-interface Fresnel/Snell/TIR radiance transport on Metal/WebGPU
tracks.remaining_scope: Source material extensions, rough transmission, nested media, richer layering and sparse media retain separate gates. GPU Principled alpha, conductor, single-interface coat and ideal dielectric are validated with shared secondary base-level textures. Named UV selection applies across render, alpha, displacement and bake consumers.
tracks.export_profile: gltf2-evaluated-pbr-export-v1; selected evaluated surface/pose with embedded resources and explicit authoring/render-recipe losses

tracks.title: Animated and rigged scenes
deliverables: Typed clips and channels with stepped, linear and cubic interpolation
Quaternion rotation, rest/bind transforms and stable joint hierarchy
Linear blend skinning, morph targets and explicit topology/weight validation
Immutable evaluation at rational times, random frame access and sequence rendering
acceptance: Import, save/reopen and render a rigged external character sequence without Blender
Verify interpolation, bind/rest poses and deformed positions against analytic fixtures
Render frames out of order and check that pose state does not leak between requests
Exercise cancellation, budgets and native/browser equivalence
tracks.qualification: Animation/skin file import does not imply control-rig, IK, driver or retargeting support; those retain named M08 subgates.
tracks.implemented_profile: native-authored affine-lbs-shutter-v0 and gltf2-animated-pbr-v0 on native/Wasm; gpu-f32-animation-v0 frames and streaming sequences on Metal/WebGPU; gltf2-sparse-uv0-v1 accessor capability; gltf2-morph-frames-v1 POSITION/NORMAL/TANGENT deltas with opt-in authored deformation frames; gltf2-vertex-color-v1 linear COLOR_0 on CPU/Metal/WebGPU with CPU/Metal/WebGPU Principled MASK/BLEND coverage; gpu-f32-principled-alpha-v1 MASK/BLEND with selected UV/vertex alpha, bounded visibility and shutter failure propagation; gpu-f32-conductor-coat-v1 native-authored conductor and single-interface coat on Metal/WebGPU with shared alpha and shutter workflows; gpu-f32-dielectric-v1 native-authored ideal geometric-interface Fresnel/Snell/TIR radiance transport on Metal/WebGPU
tracks.remaining_scope: Morph UV/color attributes, extensions, larger source profiles and animated glTF export remain unsupported. Authored normal/tangent directions use the explicit snapshot-v13 affine frame policy.
tracks.export_profile: gltf2-evaluated-pbr-export-v1; selected evaluated surface/pose with embedded resources and explicit authoring/render-recipe losses

tracks.title: Renderable curves and hair
deliverables: Authored curves/strands with basis, radius and local identities
Evaluated curve intersections or explicitly bounded tessellation
Named hair scattering profile and generated GPU support
Strand deformation at evaluated times
acceptance: Save/reload/render a groom with visible strand radii and supported shading
Check geometric approximation bounds and energy/sampling behavior
Measure memory and intersection costs on declared strand counts
Prove native/browser local rendering for the published budget profile
tracks.qualification: Loading points or drawing line widgets does not complete the hair-rendering gate. Hair dynamics remain a separate M11 capability.
tracks.implemented_profile: native typed curves and guide-root-sweep-v0 with deformation-aware anchors
tracks.remaining_scope: Additional strand input adapters, physical fiber BSDF and animated-groom corpus remain separate extensions.

tracks.title: Renderable volumes
deliverables: Sparse typed fields with density, emission and index-to-world semantics
Rust-owned volume input profiles and bounded paging
Transmittance, scattering/phase sampling and volumetric lighting on CPU/GPU
acceptance: Render an imported density/emission fixture after native save/reload
Validate homogeneous-slab transmittance and heterogeneous convergence
Verify sparse memory behavior, cancellation and budget rejection
Match native/browser images under declared statistical tolerances
tracks.qualification: Volume rendering is distinct from smoke/liquid simulation. No OpenVDB computational runtime is permitted.
tracks.implemented_profile: native typed sparse-media-v0, native/browser Rust CPU
tracks.remaining_scope: External sparse-volume formats, paging and GPU transport remain unsupported.

tracks.title: Native Blender file profiles
deliverables: Versioned Rust .blend reader with explicit supported file versions and encodings
Static scene hierarchy, meshes, transforms, cameras and supported materials
Source-preserving handling and per-feature diagnostics for unknown data
Progressively integrate supported animation, hair, volume and modifier semantics as their native evaluators ship
acceptance: Read, persist and render licensed .blend fixtures without a Blender process or conversion service
Publish a version-by-feature corpus including negative and malformed files
Compare geometry, transforms and supported outputs against development reference data
Never treat preserved node/modifier/driver bytes as evaluated behavior
tracks.qualification: Arbitrary .blend fidelity, embedded Python and unrestricted add-on execution are not promised. Animated, hair and volume profiles additionally depend on INPUT-03/04/05; procedural modifiers depend on M06.
